title: Inquietude
summary: INQUI'ETUDE, noun [Latin inquietudo; in and quies, rest.] Disturbed state; want of quiet; restlessness; uneasiness, either of body or mind; disquietude.

inlines.v: INQUI'ETUDE, noun [Latin inquietudo; in and quies, rest.] Disturbed state; want of quiet; restlessness; uneasiness, either of body or mind; disquietude.
